meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Signal 与你聊天。它把你的 Signal 账号作为辅助设备链接到 NanoClaw，用你手机上的号码收发消息，并支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复和打字提示。
howto.when: 当你想把 Signal 接入 NanoClaw，让助手用你的手机号码收发消息时使用。它会在配置过程中触发安装、设备链接等步骤。

say.note: 开始安装 signal-cli 并链接你的设备。

say.text: 链接我的 Signal 账号
say.note: 显示二维码供手机扫描，完成设备链接。

say.text: 配置 Signal 渠道，让我用手机号收发消息
say.note: 完成安装和账号绑定，即可用 Signal 对话。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can chat with you over Signal. It links your Signal account as a secondary device to NanoClaw, using your phone number to send and receive messages, and supports Markdown formatting, quoted replies, and typing indicators.
howto.when_en: Use this skill when you want to integrate Signal into NanoClaw, so the assistant can send and receive messages via your phone number. It triggers during setup to install and link the device.

say_en.note: Starts installing signal-cli and linking your device.
Shows a QR code for your phone to scan.

say_en.text: Set up Signal so I can message you on my number
say_en.note: Completes setup and binds the account.
